hints.title: Equation Transformation
hints.text: Rearrange nums[i] + rev(nums[j]) == nums[j] + rev(nums[i]) into nums[i] - rev(nums[i]) == nums[j] - rev(nums[j]).

hints.title: Transformed Difference Counting
hints.text: Compute the difference diff = x - rev(x) for each element and group identical difference values.

hints.title: Combinatorial Pair Calculation
hints.text: For each distinct difference with count c, add c * (c - 1) / 2 to the total modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: max_val is maximum value in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs of elements naively takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping identical transformed differences enables O(n) linear counting with hash map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms algebraic equation to isolate variables of the same index.
